a: Paris is the capital and largest city of France.
Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany.
New Delhi is the capital of India.
Washington, D.C. is the capital of the United States.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
The speed of light in a vacuum is approximately 299,792,458 meters per second (about 300,000 km/s).
Hydrogen is the first element on the periodic table with the symbol H.
William Shakespeare wrote the tragedy Hamlet around the year 1600.
Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the moon in 1969 during the Apollo 11 mission.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions.
Mount Everest is Earth's highest mountain above sea level, located in the Himalayas.
An adult human has 206 bones in their body.
Pi (π) is approximately 3.14159, representing the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.
